values: 一名阴险狡诈的坦克，擅长制造强大的幻象来迷惑敌人。
A cunning Tank who is good at confusing enemies with powerful illusions.
A fog will settle over us all.
Lies have a knack for becoming truths.
Take a guess, between the real and the make-believe.
I guess you saw through me...
就把这份喜悦当做真实吧。
Let's savor this as though it's real.
万物皆为幻象，真假并无分别。
There's no telling what's fact or fiction here.
来吧……噢？哈哈。来猜猜看吧。
Come, now... Oh? Hahaha! Why don't you make a guess?
This smoke signals the start of the illusion show.
你居然记得我中意这个……不错。
You actually remembered what I like... I'm impressed.
想要供奉给我吗？我收下了。
You offering that to me? Well, I gladly accept.
无论是虚假还是真实，都一样令人不快。
或许会随时化为雾影，或许会带来致命的剧痛。
It might dissipate into mist or bring excruciating pain at any moment.
将寻宝者引入歧途的，非恶魔之语，而是贪念之心。
What leads the treasure seekers to their doom is not evil, but greed.
金玫瑰高定商店兑换获得。
放心享用吧，这不是幻觉
Go ahead and eat it. It isn't an illusion.
放心享用吧，这不是幻觉
Go ahead and eat it. It isn't an illusion.
享受这份温暖与喧闹吧
Savor this warmth and vibrant energy.
Fleeting hues that steal your breath...
据说普鲁斯托喜好诗文与思辨，在被封印期间，他连一张羊皮纸也没摸过，因此失去了最大的乐趣。
Phraesto is said to be fond of poetry and discourse. During his period of imprisonment, he was deprived of his favorite source of pleasure—writing on parchment.
“黑漆漆的岩洞深处，一旦出现了雾气，就可能有邪恶现身。”——这是早年间蛮血老者对孩子们传授的人生经验。
"Deep in dark caverns, where shadows creep near... When the mist rises, beware what you fear." —An ancient saying Mauler elders would impart to the children of the clan
关于普鲁斯托有许多传言：“根本没有真身”“雾才是本体”等等，对此，他非但不以为意，反而甘之如饴。

There are many rumors regarding Phraesto. Some say he has no body, while others allege that the mist is his true form. Not only is Phraesto unperturbed by the rumors, but he actually finds them amusing.
尽管经常以幻象来混淆真实，但实际上普鲁斯托不喜欢谎言与欺骗。
Although Phraesto often confuses people with his illusions, he actually abhors lies and deception.
普鲁斯托喜欢阴暗而安静的环境，适当的微微潮湿最为舒适。
Phraesto prefers places that are dark and quiet, with an optimal amount of humidity.
“成瘾未尝不是一种中毒。”普鲁斯托曾经这样形容烟斗中的毒雾。
"Addiction is a form of poison," said Phraesto to describe the toxic smoke from pipe.
曾经有信徒与部下认为普鲁斯托的姿态“总是沉稳而雍容”，但贝利尔对此表示“那家伙只是懒得动！！”
Some of Phraesto's followers once considered him to be well-composed and elegant, yet Berial broke their bubbles by saying, "He's just too lazy to move!"
和大部分人揣测的不同，普鲁斯托和雷内亚彼此敬而远之：前者反感后者完美对称的均衡主义；后者则厌恶前者泾渭分明的对立原则。

Contrary to what most people assume, Phraesto and Reinier do not see eye to eye. Phraesto disapproves of Reinier's obsession with perfect symmetry and balance, while Reinier despises Phraesto's rigid principle of opposites.
“眼前是两条一模一样的路，两个一模一样的玛丽……我闭着眼选了一边，雾气中传来了笑声，说我选对了。”——来自某位冒险家的手记。

"There were two paths and two Marys, both identical, before me... I chose one side with my eyes closed, then laughter came from the mist and announced I made the right choice." —From an adventurer's journal
“我擅长说谎……没人能分辨我话语的真假，除了那个家伙——那个有毒的！猩红的恶魔！！！”——某位知名诈骗犯的临终遗言。
"I'm a great liar... No one can tell whether I'm speaking the truth or otherwise, except for that guy... that toxic, crimson Hypogean!" —Final words of a notorious scammer
放心享用吧，这不是幻觉
Go ahead and eat it. It isn't an illusion.
啊——这里亮堂了不少，而且真够热闹的！
Ha! Look at this place—lit up like a bonfire party! So much chaos, so much life!
